h: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ תַּמּוּז, א׳ Rosh Chodesh Tammuz, 1

p: It is stated in Sefer Yetzirah:
"He crowned the letter ches in sight," etc.,
and the right hand in the soul," etc.
the connection of ches in sight to the right hand.
And the right eye he did not list here,
for among the seven days he listed
"the first day and the right eye," etc.
from the side of the right of Avraham,
where there is the sight of Torah:
'From His right hand, a fiery law for them.'"
אִי אַתָּה רַשַּׁאי לְאוֹמְרָן בְּעַל פֶּה
you are not permitted to say by heart"
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב.
"And Elokim saw the light, that it was good."
where something is mentioned for the first time in the Torah,
there lies the root of the matter,
about the letter tes, that it indicates good,
אַף שֶׁיֵּשׁ ט׳ לְהֵיפֶךְ גַּם כֵּן,
even though there is also a tes for the opposite,
only since the pasuk opened with it
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
"And Elokim saw the light, that it was good"
because the pasuk opened with it
first regarding the light, as mentioned above,
it is the essential root of sight.
And the light in this pasuk
refers to the light of Torah,
in the pasuk of 'Let there be light,'
corresponding to the five Chumashim of the Torah";
for before that there was darkness,
and night is not a time of seeing,
as Chazal said in the Gemara (Shabbos 27b):
this excludes a night garment," etc.,
since it is not seen by others.
And when light came into being,
there came to be a time of seeing.
And before this a ches is written:
that the letter ches is mentioned
before the utterance "Let there be light,"
two more occurrences of the letter ches,
in the words "and the spirit of Elokim was hovering," etc.
"They made a peak on the roof of the ches,
כְּלוֹמַר חַי הוּא בְּרוּמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם.
as if to say: He lives in the heights of the world."
אוֹת ח׳ מוֹרָה עַל עִיקַּר הַחַיִּים,
the letter ches indicates the essence of life,
and that is Hashem Yisbarach, Who is called
וְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וְאוֹרַיְיתָא חַד הוּא,
And the Holy One, blessed be He, and the Torah are one,
for the Holy One, blessed be He, is called Torah,
וְאֵין תּוֹרָה אֶלָּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא,
and "Torah is none other than the Holy One, blessed be He,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב ס, א).
וְהַתּוֹרָה נִקְרָא גַּם כֵּן סְתָם חַיִּים,
And the Torah is also called simply "life,"
as in "See, I have placed before you
But He is "in the heights of the world,"
meaning that He is exalted above the entire world,
the Hidden Intellect, concealed from all thought,
and no thought can grasp Him,
and this is "in the heights of the world."
And this is why the ches is mentioned first
And afterwards a second ches is written
in the words "and the spirit of Elokim,"
"This is the spirit of the King Mashiach";
and about him it is written (Daniel 7:13):
"And behold, with the clouds of heaven
one like a son of man was coming,
and he reached the Ancient of Days,
and they brought him near before Him."
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁהוּא נִבְרָא עוֹד בְּמַאֲמָר רִאשׁוֹן,
That is, he was created already in the first utterance,
which is concealed from all thought,
it is concealed from all thought,
in the aspect of darkness — "He made darkness His concealment" —
from this the deeds of the wicked are drawn,
for since the light is hidden,
that there is a Creator and Ruler of the world,
it is possible for someone to forget,
these refer to the deeds of the wicked.
And for this reason the third ches is written
in the word merachefes, "hovering over the face of the waters,"
For Mashiach will be an individual who returns in teshuvah,
for on account of one individual who has done teshuvah
all of a person's deeds for the good,
"'If your sins be like scarlet' — like the years,
these that are arranged and come
from the six days of Creation —
And this is why in the first utterance
the deeds of the wicked are mentioned,
for such was the creation of the world:
that is, so that the light should be recognized,
like the distinction of light from darkness,
for "there is no light except that
and he grasped the entire Torah
from the creation of the world,
"And your eyes shall see your Teacher" —
that from everything a person sees
that there is a Creator and Ruler of the world.
there the lesson is more explicit,
but in truth from all created beings
לֹא נִבְרָא אֶלָּא בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה וְכוּלֵּי,
was created only for the sake of this one," etc.,
"only to be a companion to this one."
And why is a whole world needed
one can learn words of Torah,
with which heaven and earth were created.
And so Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה לט, א) עָלָיו:
as Chazal said about him (Bereishis Rabbah 39:1):
He said, 'Shall you say that this palace
And from this he grasped all the words of Torah.
And this is what is expounded (Bereishis Rabbah 2:3):
"'Let there be light' — this is Avraham,"
for he was the beginning of the light,
and this is the essence of sight,
רַק דִּבְּרָה תוֹרָה כִּלְשׁוֹן בְּנֵי אָדָם,
rather, the Torah speaks in human language,
and "great is the power of the prophets,
who liken the form to its Maker"
וְאַף הַתּוֹרָה כָּתְבָה עַל ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ
and even the Torah wrote about Hashem Yisbarach
for the creation of the world,
And Avraham is the aspect of the right,
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 218b)
Chessed and Gevurah are called "the two arms,"
and Avraham is called "the right arm,"
and "From His right hand, a fiery law for them."
And this is what is said in the holy Zohar
which alludes to words of Torah,
"The king is not saved by a great army"
"from the side of the right of Avraham,
where there is the sight of Torah:
'From His right hand, a fiery law for them.'"
So too, the seven days of Creation
and the seven shepherds, as is known,
and the first day corresponds to Avraham.
And this is what is said in Sefer Yetzirah cited above:
and the right eye in the soul," etc.;
and on the first day light and sight were created,
and the ches is also mentioned.
"'By His right hand' — this is Torah;
'and by the arm of His strength' — these are tefillin."
to those who walk in the good path,
"The heart of a wise man is at his right,"
and the left alludes to those who veer left.
And this is "By His right hand — this is Torah":
those who walk in the good path;
and "by the arm of His strength — these are tefillin":
that is, to bind the deeds of the hand,
so that it does the will of the Omnipresent.
comes after the month of Sivan,
in which the Torah was given.
Had it not been for the downfall,
the Written Torah alone would have sufficed,
only the five Chumashim of the Torah," etc.;
and from that they would have seen and recognized everything,
as it will be in the future:
כִּי כוּלָּם יֵדְעוּ אוֹתִי [יִרְמְיָה לא, לג].
they needed the Torah she'b'al peh,
everything was from the side of the Tree of Life,
and afterwards it came to be
from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil,
where there are forbidden and permitted,
impure and pure, kosher and invalid,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ [חֵלֶק א כז, א].
as stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 27a).
That is, even in words of Torah
there are those who go right and those who veer left.
And regarding those occupied with Torah she'b'al peh
"the light that was created on the first day,
which the Holy One, blessed be He, hid away
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh," etc.;
they bring out the primordial light
And this is what shines forth
through the crown of the yud
to the yud, which is Chochmah;
for the four letters of the Name Havayah
and the crown on the yud
And for this reason the holy Zohar
counts the utterance "Let there be light" as the first utterance,
since it comes after the primordial light was hidden,
and it is the crown of the yud
And this is what is said in Sefer Yetzirah:
"He crowned the letter ches in sight";
is to see and recognize the light,
and its essence is the hidden light,
and it comes from the letter ches,
only He is "in the heights of the world,"
and that is the essence of sight.
And this is what is said in the Ra'aya Mehemna
"Men of valor — from the side of the right
where there is the sight of Torah," etc.;
דְּחַיִל מְרַמֵּז עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
for chayil, valor, alludes to Torah she'b'al peh,
לֹא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְלֹא בָּעוֹלָם הַבָּא,
neither in this world nor in the World to Come,
and from beis midrash to beis midrash;
and this is the sight of the Torah she'b'al peh.
And in the commentary of the Ra'avad on Sefer Yetzirah,
on what it says, "and Cancer in the world,"
he wrote that the crab is a creature of the water,
and in water there are bad and good:
and that of weeping, whose tear
and the secret is, "And behold, there the women
יֵשׁ לוֹ גִּירְסָא אַחֶרֶת בְּסֵפֶר יְצִירָה
has a different version of Sefer Yetzirah
and does not have the reading "sight";
אַךְ דְּבָרָיו יֵשׁ לָהֶם שַׁיָּיכוּת לְהָבִין
but his words are relevant for understanding
even according to the version we cited,
which is the version of the Arizal.
The point is that water has bad and good:
and there are also "the wanton waters" —
similar to what is written in the Midrash
(בַּמִּדְבַּר רַבָּה כ, כב; תַּנְחוּמָא בָּלָק יז):
"There are springs that raise mighty men," etc.,
and some raise people steeped in lewdness," etc.
And the month of Tammuz, which comes
after the month of Sivan, as mentioned above,
was created with the letter ches, in sight —
that is, the sight of Torah,
which comes from the primordial light;
and the ches indicates that He is living,
but in the heights of the world, as mentioned above.
שֶׁהוּא מִסִּטְרָא דְּעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע,
which is from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil,
can also have those who veer left,
for the yetzer hara is able
and to make darkness into light,
"He appeared to him like a talmid chacham" —
that he appeared to Yaakov Avinu
as a rabbi guiding along the good path.
חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה פָּנִים בְּתוֹרַת כֹּהֲנִים וְכוּלֵּי,
fifty-five facets in Toras Kohanim," etc.;
and we said that this is the gematria of egel, "calf";
that is, he showed facets in Toras Kohanim
and these are the ones who veer left.
וְעַל יְדֵי אוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And through the light of Torah she'b'al peh
one can merit sight from the letter ches,
the primordial light that is hidden
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh,
which shines from Kesser Elyon into Chochmah.
And this is in the month of Tammuz,
which comes after the month of Sivan,
for then is the time of attaining the light
and that is a sight of joy
and "the precepts of Hashem are upright, gladdening the heart."
וּבְהֵיפֶךְ נִמְצָא גַּם כֵּן אָז בַּקְּלִיפָּה,
And the opposite is also found then in the kelipah,
in that they weep for the Tammuz,
This is along the lines of what is said in the Ra'aya Mehemna
that on Shabbos, when Yisrael are
with many lights and delights, etc.,
they cause the evil maidservant to remain
in darkness, in hunger, in weeping
and in lament, in black garments,
דְּאִי מְלֵאָה זוֹ חֲרֵבָה זוֹ וְכוּלֵּי.
for if this one is full, that one is desolate," etc.
So too on Rosh Chodesh Tammuz:
since the holiness of this month is sight,
to attain the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
therefore the opposite is found correspondingly:
גַּם כֵּן עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה מְבַכּוֹת אֶת הַתַּמּוּז,
the idolaters, too, weep for the Tammuz,
as written in the Moreh Nevuchim
whose adherents hold a great observance
And this is "He crowned the letter ches in sight,
and Cancer in the world, and Tammuz in the year":
עַל רְאִיַּית אוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה.
the seeing of the light of Torah she'b'al peh.
"And the right hand in the soul":
from the side of the right,
of Avraham, who is called "the right arm";
and all actions are named after the hands,
"that I toiled with my ten fingers in Torah,"
אַף שֶׁהַלִּימּוּד אֵינוֹ עַל יְדֵי הַיָּדַיִם.
even though learning is not done with the hands.
חָשַׁב גַּם כֵּן שְׁנֵי חֳדָשִׁים, תַּמּוּז וְאָב,
also counted two months, Tammuz and Av,
since he counts the six winter months as the King's
and the summer months as the Matrona's.
That is, from the side of Yisrael;
for Tishrei has its letters in reverse,
the flow of light from Above to below,
while Nissan is called Aviv — letters in their order,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפו, א),
as stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 186a);
that is, from the side of Yisrael,
And this month is the right eye of the Matrona,
namely, sight in Torah she'b'al peh.
And afterwards it begins once again:
"'And there was light' — this is Rosh Hashanah,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּתִּיקּוּנִים (תִּקּוּן לו, עז, ב),
Tishrei, from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
from Above to below, as mentioned above.
And this is the main task of this month.
שֶׁכָּל חוֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ לוֹ קְדוּשָּׁה מְיוּחֶדֶת
For each month has a unique holiness
"the burnt-offering of each month in its month";
that is, the letter with which it was created.
And the holiness of this month
is in the sight of Torah:
to attain through toil in words of Torah
the hidden light from the letter ches —
and "He lives in the heights of the world";
and this is the essence of sight:
to see the light of Torah,
in connection with which sight is mentioned
for the first time in the Torah:
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב:
"And Elokim saw the light, that it was good."
